thread:
Alex M.: Kicking off onramp for sa-east-2 (osm-3). Need to run a quick connectivity + GPU smoke window tonight 22:00 UTC. Sharing condensed validation checklist below — please ack and pick tasks. @Mira P. can you validate NVLINK and driver state?
Mira P.: Ack. I'll check NVLINK lanes and driver matrix. ETA ~45m. Any firmware microcode we should lock to for this run?
Alex M.: Use driver 545.23 and microcode v2.1.3 (prod baseline). If we see mismatch >1 node, prefer drain + reprovision rather than patching in place.
Jordan K.: Noted. Also flagging cost guardrails — cap burst/spot nodes to 20% of pool during ramp. Finance wants a quick estimate before we exceed that.
Liam S.: I'll run network path checks + e2e perf: traceroutes, `iperf3` between AZ peers, then a small inference job to validate p95. Plan: 100MB streams and synthetic 1-token workload.
sre-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy for runtime v1.8 started on cluster osm-3; 4/4 pods ready. Logs: `runtime-init OK`
Ops Runbooks: Checklist (condensed):
```
- PRE: verify firmware/drivers, kernel params (transparent hugepages off), ulimits, nvidia-smi health
- FABRIC: control plane reachability, vxlan/eni tests, MTU sanity, iperf between subnets
- GPU SMOKE: small bert/gpt microbench (latency + throughput), ECC checks, nvlink peer-to-peer test
- KV CACHE: load a synthetic KV workload and validate hit-rate and warmup times
- SLO GATES: p50/p95 latency, error-rate, token throughput baselines
- CANARY: 100 users synthetic traffic, compare outputs vs golden set
- HANDOFF: post-check report, costs uplift, open issues list
```
Alex M.: For SLOs: target p50 < 40ms, p95 < 200ms on small generators; error-rate < 0.5%; baseline throughput ~120 tok/s per V100-equivalent GPU. We'll run synthetic load to validate.
Mira P.: Observation: 2 nodes reporting ECC warnings after driver upgrade. Running `./tools/ecc-check.sh --nodes node-347,node-358`. If it persists we'll reprovision those two.
Jordan K.: If reprovisioning, prefer swapping to reserved-capacity nodes to avoid a billing spike on spots. I'll update the cost delta and post a short table before ramp.
Liam S.: Network test quick results: `iperf3` shows 9.2 Gbps between nodes (10G expected), p99 latency ~1.9ms. Traceroute fine. Tagging @oncall for possible NIC tuning later.
Alex M.: :thumbsup: Window confirmed 22:00 UTC. Who's owning the post-check handoff doc and quick SLO snapshot?
Ops Runbooks: I'll author the handoff note and publish to the runbook repo. Draft will include: PV migration state, node health list, SLO snapshot (p50/p95/error-rate), canary request sample, and any outstanding remediation. Will post draft by 23:15 UTC.
sre-bot: incident-bot: automated SLO check ran pre-window — all gates passing. p95 latency 180ms, error-rate 0.02%.
Alex M.: Thanks everyone. Please annotate any findings directly in the draft so we can have a single source for the post-mortem if needed.
